what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Algeria in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5965 Algerian asylum seekers in Canada, 46.1% of all asylum seekers from Algeria.
Refugees from Algeria, a separate group, live mostly in France, Canada, Germany and Portugal.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Algeria in every year from 1995 to 2018 and in 2020, with the GIA and AQIM among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Algeria in 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 348 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
